output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply and balanceOf[_owner] are both increased by mintedAmount without a check, allowing the owner to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens to any user account, causing a denial of service to the token buyer.

The transfer function has a wrong logic where it allows the owner to transfer tokens to any user account, allowing the owner to arbitrarily set the balance of any user to any value, causing a financial loss to the user.

The transferFrom function has a wrong logic where it allows the owner to transfer tokens from any user account to any user account, allowing the owner to arbitrarily set the balance of any user to any value, causing a financial loss to the user.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is multiplied by sellPrice, and the result is used in a subsequent multiplication with buyPrice, causing an overflow and reducing the amount of tokens the caller receives, allowing a caller to buy a large amount of tokens at a low price.

The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The msg.value is divided by buyPrice, and the result is used in a subsequent multiplication with buyPrice, causing an overflow and allowing a caller to buy a large amount of tokens at a low price, causing a financial loss to the caller.
